evidence.reason: The regex still uses `(.+)`, and JavaScript `.` does not match line terminators. `git ls-files --stage -z` emits filenames verbatim and NUL-terminates records, so a tracked filename containing a line break makes this `exec` return null, throwing `terminal foreign index entry unsupported` and aborting settlement even for an unrelated unchanged path. The minimal repair is to parse the fixed prefix through the tab and take the remaining text up to the existing NUL slice as the filename, or use a line-terminator-safe character class.
